sources.title: gpt-oss: How to Run Guide | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: OpenAI releases ' gpt-oss-120b' and ' gpt-oss-20b', two SOTA open language models under the Apache 2.0 license. Both 128k context models outperform similarly sized open models in reasoning, tool use, and agentic tasks. You can now run & fine-tune them locally with Unsloth! Run gpt-oss-20b Run gpt-oss-120b Fine-tune gpt-oss Fine-tune gpt-oss-20b for free with our Colab notebook Trained with RL ...

sources.title: Tutorial: How to Fine-tune gpt-oss | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Learn step-by-step how to train OpenAI gpt-oss locally with Unsloth. In this guide with screenshots, you'll learn to fine-tune your own custom gpt-oss model either locally on your machine with Unsloth or for free using Google Colab. We'll walk you through the entire process, from setup to running and saving your trained model.
